question: Can a source-only predictor of a low-rank bank of bounded explicit residual LUTs improve both mean and tail neutral-target error over one global LUT on three already-seen FiveK development populations, while preserving analytical gamut safety before unchanged AO6?

development_populations.name: ay3_seen_fresh
development_populations.evaluation: source-only prediction from the full AY0 development fit

development_populations.name: ay6_seen_confirmation
development_populations.evaluation: source-only prediction from the full AY0 development fit; explicitly development-only because AY6 outcomes are already seen

operator.node_order: r-major then g then b, RGB residual at each node
operator.execution: trilinear interpolation followed by one analytical shared RGB residual scale per pixel

basis_prediction.basis: training-only PCA of fitted residual LUT vectors
basis_prediction.alpha_selection: inner camera-group cross-validation on AY0 outer-development only

branch_rules.all_gates_pass: freeze the complete LUT fit, basis, predictor and safety executor; then acquire one new disjoint official FiveK population for unchanged confirmation before any blind product-value test
branch_rules.oracle_fails: close this LUT representation capacity without predictor rescue
branch_rules.predictor_or_tail_fails: close this fixed basis/predictor pair without tuning grid, rank, regularization, descriptor, alpha, target or AO6 on outcomes
branch_rules.boundary_fails: close as implementation or safety failure before visual review

claim_ceiling: development-only image-adaptive explicit LUT-basis evidence on already-seen digital-retouch pairs before fixed AO6; not confirmation, film, stock, calibration, preference or product promotion
